build_nnls_regression: build a non-negative least squares regression model using LinearRegression with positive=True constraint
build_ols_regression: build an ordinary least squares regression model using LinearRegression without constraints
test_r2_score: test the r2_score metric from sklearn.metrics to evaluate regression model predictions
run_train_test_split: run train_test_split from sklearn.model_selection to divide data into train and test sets
review_plot_coefficients: review plotting OLS vs NNLS regression coefficients using matplotlib scatter comparison
